title: Elf Bar ElfLiq Snoow Tobacco Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Cream Tobacco from ElfLiq’s range of nic salt e-liquids is a uniquely delicious take on a handmade Cuban cigarillo. The rich, robust and earthy tobacco flavour is mellowed to perfection with warm hints of sweet vanilla crème. Elfliq e-liquids are Elf Bar’s most iconic flavours in 10ml bottles of nicotine salt e-liquid. With a 50% VG / 50% PG concentration, Elfliq liquids produce a discreet amount of flavour-rich vapour with a smooth, comfortable throat hit, and provide rapid relief from nicotine cravings. Elfliq nicotine salt e-liquids are available in 10mg or 20mg nicotine strength and are ideal for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts.
